title: Heal

[[Image:Heal.png|right|160px]]
'''Heal''' is a [[spell]].  It first appeared in the [[Arkham Horror]] board game.

==Card info==
'''Casting Modifier''': +1

'''Sanity Cost''': 1

'''Upkeep Phase''': You may cast and exhaust.  You or another [[investigator]] in your area gains [[Stamina]] equal to the successes you rolled on your [[Spell check]].  This Stamina cannot be split between multiple investigators.
